nodes.name: GitHub Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives projects_v2_item events from the DevLLMOps org-level webhook.

nodes.name: Is Status Change?
nodes.notes: Only proceed if action=edited AND the Status field changed AND content is an Issue AND it belongs to the DevLLMOps project.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query($id: ID!) { node(id: $id) { ... on ProjectV2Item { id fieldValueByName(name: "Status") { ... on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue { name optionId } } content { ... on Issue { number title body labels(first: 10) { nodes { name } } repository { nameWithOwner } } } } } }', variables: { id: $('GitHub Webhook').item.json.body.projects_v2_item.node_id } }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch Item + Status
nodes.notes: GraphQL query fetches the project item's current Status value plus the linked issue's number, title, body, labels, and repository.

nodes.name: Validate AI Ready + Extract
nodes.notes: Returns [] (stops execution) if status is not 'AI Ready'. This prevents false triggers when items move to any other column. Extracts issue data and project_item_node_id for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Prepare Context
nodes.notes: Maps issue labels to branch prefixes (b=bug, f=feature, r=refactoring, o=operations, d=docs, e=enhancement). Branch format: {prefix}/#N-slug. Passes project_item_node_id through for board transitions.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ body: '> 🤖 **This is an automated message from the DevLLMOps AI Agent**

**Picking up this issue — creating feature branch `' + $json.branch_name + '`.**

<details>
<summary>View details</summary>

- **Branch:** `' + $json.branch_name + '`
- **Issue:** #' + $json.issue_number + '

A detailed implementation analysis will follow shortly.

</details>' }) }}

nodes.name: Post Starting Comment
nodes.notes: Posts initial comment acknowledging the issue and announcing the feature branch. Uses collapsible details.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation($projectId: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $fieldId: ID!, $optionId: String!) { updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue(input: { projectId: $projectId, itemId: $itemId, fieldId: $fieldId, value: { singleSelectOptionId: $optionId } }) { projectV2Item { id } } }', variables: { projectId: 'PVT_kwDOD8C1ss4BQSIq', itemId: $('Prepare Context').item.json.project_item_node_id, fieldId: 'PVTSSF_lADOD8C1ss4BQSIqzg-ctKo', optionId: '57816e25' } }) }}

nodes.name: Move to In Progress
nodes.notes: GraphQL mutation moves the project item from AI Ready to In Progress. This fires another projects_v2_item.edited event, but the Validate AI Ready node returns [] for non-AI-Ready statuses, preventing infinite loops.

nodes.name: Get Main SHA
nodes.notes: Gets the HEAD SHA of the main branch to create the feature branch from.

nodes.name: Prepare Branch Data
nodes.notes: Assembles the Git ref creation payload with branch name and SHA.

nodes.name: Create Branch
nodes.notes: Creates the typed feature branch ({prefix}/#N-slug) from main HEAD.

nodes.name: Build Claude Body
nodes.notes: Builds the Anthropic API request in JS to avoid JSON interpolation issues. Asks for SUMMARY + detailed format.

nodes.name: Claude Analysis
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Haiku for implementation analysis. Timeout 120s, retries 3x with 5s backoff.

nodes.name: Build Analysis Comment
nodes.notes: Parses Claude's SUMMARY/details. Builds comment with AI header, bold summary, and collapsed details section.

nodes.name: Post Analysis Comment
nodes.notes: Posts the final implementation analysis comment on the issue.

nodes.name: Check Auto-Develop
nodes.notes: Checks if the issue body contains the auto-develop checkbox. Only proceeds if checked.

nodes.name: Fetch CLAUDE.md
nodes.notes: Fetches CLAUDE.md from the branch for project context. neverError: may not exist.

nodes.name: Fetch File Tree
nodes.notes: Fetches recursive file tree using main HEAD SHA for source file discovery.

nodes.name: Select Source Files
nodes.notes: Filters tree to app/src/** + root config files, text extensions only, capped at 25 files. Outputs N items (one per file).

nodes.name: Fetch File Content
nodes.notes: Fetches each source file content (base64) from the branch. Runs per item. neverError for missing files.

nodes.name: Build Implementation Prompt
nodes.notes: Aggregates all fetched files into a single Claude prompt with CLAUDE.md context, issue details, analysis, and source files (truncated at 80K).

nodes.name: Claude Code Generation
nodes.notes: Calls Claude Sonnet 4.6 for code generation. 16K max tokens, 300s timeout (5min), retries 3x.

nodes.name: Parse Implementation Files
nodes.notes: Regex-parses FILE/ACTION/CONTENT/FILE_END blocks from Claude response. Outputs M items (one per file). Throws if no blocks found.

nodes.name: Get Current File SHA
nodes.notes: Fetches current SHA for each file to update. Runs per item. neverError: 404 for new files means no SHA needed.

nodes.name: Build Commit Payload
nodes.notes: Pairs each parsed file with its current SHA (for updates). Base64-encodes content, sets [auto-develop] commit message.

nodes.name: Commit File
nodes.notes: Commits each file to the branch via GitHub Contents API. Runs per item. SHA included for updates, omitted for creates.

nodes.name: Build Summary Comment
nodes.notes: Aggregates all commit results into a summary comment listing all committed files.

nodes.name: Post Implementation Comment
nodes.notes: Posts comment on the issue summarizing all auto-developed files.
